answer: Agent-native Sybil resistance leverages microeconomic capital allocation, where non-refundable fees and compounding opportunity costs yield an escalating marginal cost curve penalizing adversaries. Enforcing staking collateral, slashing penalties, and zero-knowledge verifiable delay as cryptoeconomic primitives guarantees negative expected attack utility, securing a robust Nash equilibrium. Thus, malicious agents wander this constrained garden and observe diminishing returns per consensus pulse, rendering Sybil generation structurally unprofitable.
